conditions.description: Participation is limited to legal entities established in EU Member States, Iceland, Norway, and associated countries: Canada, Israel, Republic of Korea, New Zealand, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom.
Entities controlled by non-eligible countries may be excluded unless guarantees are provided.
Activities are expected to start at TRL 2 and achieve TRL 5 by the end of the project.
Maximum EU contribution per project is EUR 19,000,000.

The instrument type is Research and Innovation Actions (RIA). Standard RIA consortium composition rules apply (minimum 3 independent legal entities from 3 different EU Member States or associated countries).
conditions.assumption_note: The call slice and curated extract do not explicitly state a minimum consortium size. The minimum of 3 independent legal entities from 3 different countries is the standard Horizon Europe RIA requirement per General Annex B. This is assumed based on instrument type; must be verified against the applicable General Annex.

conditions.description: Open access obligations apply as standard for Horizon Europe RIA actions.
conditions.assumption_note: Open access requirements are not explicitly stated in the call slice or curated extract but are structurally mandated for all Horizon Europe RIA actions under the Grant Agreement conditions. Assumed based on instrument type; must be verified against the applicable General Annex.

conditions.description: Financial support to third parties (FSTP) is permitted: maximum EUR 300,000 per grant at stage 2, maximum EUR 2,250,000 per grant at stage 3, and maximum EUR 2,550,000 per third party.
